name: Sandhills Pipeline

values.EndLocation: Richmond County power plant, near Hamlet

researcher_notes: Not in the current sheet: no row matches Sandhills, Palmetto, Iredell or Richmond County. A March 2001 Progress Energy press release (PRNewswire, reprinted by Power Engineering) says its subsidiary North Carolina Natural Gas finished the 84-mile, 30-inch Sandhills Pipeline from the Transco line in Iredell County to a power plant in Richmond County near Hamlet. About 73 miles are in an existing corridor. Initial flow 200 to 300 MMcf/d, expandable to 800 with compression. The EIA pipeline projects table for August 2026, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), lists it twice: row 177 NCPL Sandhills Pipeline Project (Progress Energy, 84 mi, 30 in, 300 MMcf/d, completed March 2001, intrastate, state authority) and row 176 Palmetto Pipeline Project (Palmetto Pipeline Co, 82 mi, 30 in, 350 MMcf/d). Same endpoints, one line, so one row. Both sources trace to one origin family, so not counted as independent. Intrastate, so FERC silence is expected. Not confirmed: current owner and whether it is still operating today; the line may have passed to Piedmont Natural Gas or Duke Energy after the 2003 and 2016 deals. Owner shown is the 2001 builder, no exact gazetteer match found, needs owner-team styling. Capacity 300 is the EIA figure. No route found. New pipe is about 11 miles (84 minus 73 in existing corridor) but whole line is new pipe added in 2001, 84 mi well above 25 km. Medium confidence.
